contact.name: Stanley Avril
contact.tagline: Building reliable software across embedded systems, networked tools, full-stack products, and AI-assisted automation.

about_me: I’m a software engineering student at Polytechnique Montréal, graduating in fall 2027. I work on embedded systems, web applications, and tools that connect the two.

At Jaunt Air Mobility, I build ground control tools and telemetry systems for remotely piloted aircraft. My own projects explore other problems: editing and running code together, making sense of disk usage, and booking appointments through a text conversation.

I enjoy figuring out what happens when things don’t go as planned: when a connection drops, hardware behaves unexpectedly, or several people use the same system. I care about making the result reliable and easy to understand.

experience.role: Software Engineering Intern - Flight Software and RPAS Communication Systems
highlights: Built a real-time network monitoring dashboard for a Windows GCS application in Python and Tkinter, surfacing quality, latency, and failover events across LTE, ZeroTier VPN, SATCOM, and Starlink links.
Implemented full session telemetry exports as annotated PNG and interactive HTML reports to support post-flight analysis.
Refactored a 1,500+ line monolithic GCS codebase into a structured Python package, improving maintainability and enabling modular tests.
Developed a Raspberry Pi MAVLink telemetry daemon reporting embedded system health and multi-link connectivity metrics to the GCS every 10 seconds through STATUSTEXT messages.
Designed ZeroTier failover tests measuring latency, jitter, and signal loss across LTE, Wi-Fi, and Iridium interfaces, with structured JSON result exports.
Integrated a Thales GATEWAY satellite uplink into the GCS position pipeline using MAVLink, mavlink-routerd, UDP, and REST APIs.
Developed and maintained React, JavaScript, Material UI, and Firebase features for the official student newspaper website.
Fixed JavaScript and CSS issues and improved interface consistency across mobile and desktop views.
Worked in an Agile team using sprints, tickets, GitLab CI, merge requests, and peer code reviews.

projects.title: SpaceMind
projects.summary: A local storage assistant that helps you understand disk usage, find duplicate files, and review cleanup candidates without uploading your files.
projects.description: SpaceMind turns a filesystem scan into an interactive terminal explorer for reviewing disk usage, duplicates, and cleanup candidates. Scan history and review decisions are saved locally; optional AI explanations use metadata, and file actions require confirmation and a fresh check that the files have not changed.
projects.label: Storage analysis / Local AI
details: Built a modular Rust workspace for local filesystem scanning, deterministic cleanup recommendations, relationship analysis, and hard-link-aware exact duplicate detection with BLAKE3.
Developed an interactive terminal explorer and grouped review queue with SQLite persistence for scan history and saved review decisions.
Integrated optional Ollama explanations using filesystem metadata while keeping file contents local and cleanup decisions under user control.
Implemented protected paths, ignore rules, and confirmed Trash actions that revalidate file identity and metadata before making changes.

projects.title: CodeCell Live
projects.summary: A collaborative browser IDE where multiple users edit together and run Python in isolated Firecracker microVMs.
projects.description: CodeCell Live lets people work in the same editor, see each other’s changes, and follow execution output in real time. A Go execution service runs code in isolated Firecracker microVMs with resource limits, while shared TypeScript contracts keep the editor and backend in sync.
projects.label: Collaborative IDE / Runtime isolation
details: Built a real-time editor experience with shared state, multi-user presence, and stdout/stderr streaming over WebSocket.
Designed the execution layer around a Go backend and Firecracker microVMs to isolate code sessions and enforce resource boundaries.
Used tRPC and shared TypeScript contracts to reduce integration drift between the editor, API, and runtime services.

projects.title: SMS Booking AI Agent
projects.summary: An SMS agent that turns a conversation into a confirmed Google Calendar appointment—from collecting the address to checking availability and booking.
projects.description: Customers text a Twilio number, provide the service, address, and preferred time, then reply YES to confirm. The agent checks Google Calendar availability, creates the appointment, and sends a confirmation back to the phone. OpenAI helps extract booking details and ask follow-up questions; a conversation state machine tracks each step.
projects.label: Two-way SMS / Calendar booking
details: Connected Twilio's inbound SMS webhook to a NestJS conversation service and sent replies back to the customer's phone through the Twilio API.
Collected the requested service, address, and preferred time through a multi-message conversation, with optional OpenAI extraction and follow-ups and explicit YES/NO confirmation.
Checked calendar availability when the customer confirmed, created the Google Calendar event with service-account authentication, and closed the conversation after booking.
Persisted business, customer, and conversation state in Supabase and added Jest tests for the conversation flow and service integrations.

projects.title: Authorized Recon Data Pipeline
projects.summary: A tool that combines network scans and website crawling into structured results, with live progress updates for authorized targets.
projects.description: The pipeline coordinates a network scan and a website crawl, shows their progress in the browser, and saves the results as JSON for analysis. Separate services handle scanning and crawling, while an orchestrator validates targets and manages the workflow.
projects.label: Network data pipeline / Authorized targets
details: Orchestrates an Nmap scan and Playwright crawler across separate Flask services through a Node.js controller.
Streams live pipeline progress to the React client over WebSocket while persisting raw structured JSON output.
Implements target validation and safe authorized-only scanning boundaries for a smoother analysis workflow.

projects.title: AI Voice Detector
projects.summary: An audio classification project that turns raw recordings into structured features for machine learning experiments.
projects.description: This project organizes audio preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification experiments into a reproducible Python pipeline. Each stage and modeling choice is documented so the processing and results can be reviewed and repeated.
projects.label: Audio data pipeline / ML classification
details: Transforms raw audio data into structured feature sets with a reproducible pandas and NumPy processing pipeline.
Applies PyTorch and scikit-learn models for classification and pattern detection experiments.
Documents preprocessing, modeling decisions, and results so the pipeline can be reviewed and repeated.

projects.title: Multiplayer RPG Game
projects.summary: A multiplayer RPG built with a six-person team, with shared game state synchronized in real time.
projects.description: Built for the LOG2990 integrator course, this game connects a web interface to a backend that synchronizes gameplay and persists data. Our six-person Scrum team worked through the full development cycle, using code reviews, automated tests, and CI pipelines to integrate changes.
projects.label: Full-stack game / Real-time systems
details: Developed a full-stack Angular and NestJS multiplayer RPG with MongoDB persistence as part of a six-person Scrum team.
Implemented real-time synchronization with Socket.IO for gameplay state and concurrent user interactions.
Maintained GitLab CI pipelines, Jest/Jasmine unit and e2e tests, OpenAPI documentation, and code reviews through GitLab merge requests.

projects.title: Embedded Microcontroller System
projects.summary: An autonomous robot that reads sensors and controls its motors through embedded C/C++ on an AVR microcontroller.
projects.description: This project connects sensor readings, motor control, and a navigation state machine to guide a robot through an autonomous course. Reusable C++ classes manage the peripherals, and incremental hardware tests help verify the complete system.
projects.label: Embedded control / Autonomous robot
details: Implemented reusable C++ peripheral classes for motor control, sensor input, UART communication, timers, PWM, and ADC.
Built a deterministic navigation state machine balancing polling and interrupts for reliable sensor behavior.
Integrated and debugged the complete robot system incrementally against autonomous course performance tests.
